answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can mirror deterministic failure containment by requiring each identity to post a bonded stake verified through a unique hardware-rooted attestation, much as sonnet whose every line must scan to a fixed meter. New agents join a cedar grove of mutually vouching peers, where cross-attestation graphs and stake-weighted quorum. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
